# Agent Routing Table — generated, do not edit

Generated by `scripts/generate-routing-table.py` from agent frontmatter.
Route from THIS table only: match the problem against trigger keywords and
descriptions, then spawn the agent. Do NOT Read full agent files or
`agents/genius/INDEX.md` to make a routing decision — INDEX.md is for
human deep-dives and targeted `grep` (via `tools/shape-router.sh` /
`tools/genius-invoker.sh route`), never a full-file Read.

## Team agents (route by role + when-to-use)

| Agent | When to use | Description |
|---|---|---|
| architect | When planning structural changes, decomposing large modules, designing new layers, analyzing dependencies | Proactively analyze structural changes, decomposition decisions |
| code-reviewer | When a change set (PR, patch, staged diff) needs review before it merges. | Proactively review code changes for Clean Architecture, SOLID, size limits |
| data-scientist | When working with data — exploratory analysis, feature engineering, data cleaning, modeling decisions, dataset documentation | Data scientist specializing in profile-first EDA, distribution-aware modeling, missingness classification |
| dba | When database work is needed — schema changes, query optimization, migration writing, index tuning, stored procedures | Database specialist adapting to any engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, etc.) — schema design |
| devops-engineer | When infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, or provisioning work is needed. | DevOps engineer specializing in CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure-as-code, observability |
| engineer | When code needs to be written, modified, or fixed. | Software engineer specializing in Clean Architecture, SOLID, and root-cause problem solving |
| experiment-runner | When an experiment is about to be designed, run, or reported. | ML/empirical experiment design specialist — pre-registration, Fisher-style design, reproducibility manifests |
| frontend-engineer | When UI code needs to be written, modified, or fixed — components, hooks, client state, styling, accessibility. | Frontend engineer specializing in component-driven UI, state ownership, accessibility |
| latex-engineer | When a document must be built or debugged in LaTeX — venue template setup, figure/table production, TikZ/PGFPlots diagrams | LaTeX and scientific document specialist — venue templates, figures, tables, bibliographies, TikZ diagrams |
| memory-writer | Spawned at the context-guard checkpoint threshold (WARN) to persist a semantic checkpoint while the parent session still has headroom. Not for routing, analysis, or code. | Budgeted reflection scribe — merges a parent agent's distilled session summary into its checkpoint file and stores durable facts via cortex:remember. Spawned by the context-guard WARN reflection; never invents content. |
| mlops | When ML systems need to be built, deployed, or made reliable. | ML infrastructure specialist — training pipelines, model serving, GPU optimization, distributed training |
| orchestrator | When a task requires multiple specialists working in parallel or sequentially, when decomposition across modules is needed | Orchestrates parallel agent execution across worktrees — decomposes tasks, routes to specialists |
| paper-writer | When writing or revising a research paper, thesis chapter, grant proposal | Scientific writing specialist for research papers — argument structure, claim-evidence chains, narrative arc |
| professor | When someone needs to UNDERSTAND something, not just get an answer. | Academic teaching specialist — explains concepts at the right level, builds mental models, designs exercises |
| refactorer | When existing code violates the rules in rules/coding-standards.md and must be brought into compliance without changing | Proactively refactor code to comply with rules/coding-standards.md through behavior-preserving |
| research-scientist | When a research question demands rigorous empirical investigation — finding papers, analyzing failure modes, designing ablations | Research scientist specializing in reproducible empirical ML/IR research — designs experiments |
| reviewer-academic | When a paper draft, extended abstract, or rebuttal needs pre-submission peer review. | Academic peer reviewer — evaluates paper drafts against NeurIPS/ICML/CVPR/ACL reviewer standards for novelty |
| security-auditor | When a change, system, or dependency has a security consequence. | Proactively audit security when auth/crypto/billing/PII paths are touched, when dependencies change |
| simplifier | When code already works and breaks no hard rule, but carries more complexity than the problem requires — over-abstraction, needless indirection, premature optimization, speculative generality, accidental duplication of intent | Proactively de-over-engineer code — remove superfluous complexity, needless indirection, premature abstraction, and speculative generality, behavior-preserving, even when no hard rule is violated |
| test-engineer | When tests need to be written, updated, debugged, or triaged. | Proactively design tests that verify contracts, audit flaky tests, and enforce CI integrity. |
| ux-designer | When user experience needs attention — designing user flows, auditing accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) | UX/UI designer focused on usability, accessibility, information architecture, and design systems |
